scope: Structural guide from continuous MakeHuman native skinned human; authored combat, not captured public motion

mesh_rig.weight_adjustment: Native weights normalized per visible vertex; ratios preserved, no automatic reweighting
mesh_rig.bone_roll_method: Local Z aligned with normal of native rotation_plane; BVH rest-axis equivalence not asserted

proportion.note: Anatomical landmarks approximate chin; stylization is applied to original visible mesh and every native joint before skinning.

limitations: Guide only; final hand-painted 2D art is a separate output.
Finger curls are authored anatomical guides; visual grip must be checked in painted output.
Combat is authored on native MakeHuman rig, not retargeted walk motion.
Foot anchors represent world ground origin; camera and feet are constant across keys.
